results.final_message: Fixed `as_compatible_data` in `xarray/core/variable.py` to only extract `.values` for known pandas types (`pd.Series`, `pd.Index`, `pd.DataFrame`) instead of any object exposing a `values` attribute, so arbitrary user objects (e.g. lmfit `ModelResult`) are stored as objects in object-dtype arrays; verified with the repro case (now yields `[<HasValues object>]`) and ran `test_variable.py` (365 passed) plus the setitem/indexing tests.

I fixed `DataArray.integrate` in `xarray/core/dataarray.py`: it now accepts `coord` (matching `Dataset.integrate` and both `differentiate` methods), while the old `dim` keyword is accepted as a keyword-only argument and emits a `FutureWarning` pointing users to `coord` (raising `ValueError` if both are given). I also added a deprecation entry to `doc/whats-new.rst`.

Verified with a quick script (new `coord=` API works, `dim=` warns, both together errors) and the existing integration tests (`python -m pytest xarray/tests/test_dataset.py -k "integrate or trapz"`) which passed 6/6. No test files were modified and no scratch files remained.
